title.zh: OCC 给予 Catena 关于 National Trust Bank 的初步有条件批准
title.en: OCC Gives Catena Preliminary Conditional Approval for National Trust Bank

current_state.zh: 拟议中的银行可托管和管理法定货币、证券及数字资产，但 Catena 必须满足资本、流动性和开业前要求后才能运营。
current_state.en: The proposed bank could custody and manage fiat, securities and digital assets, but Catena must meet capital, liquidity and preopening requirements before it can operate.
